Product guides and documents

User Manual (PDF)

Product Description

Polished, Full HD video calls. The C920x Pro HD Webcam with microphone delivers remarkably crisp, clear, and detailed images in vibrant colors. This USB camera for PC features HD autofocus and light correction, adjusting to the conditions to provide consistently high definition, while the five-element glass lens delivers razor-sharp images. Dual mics, placed on either side of the lens, capture the natural sound of your voice, making it great as a webcam for PC or a webcam for Mac. The 3-month XSplit VCam license enables you to remove, replace, and blur your background. Whether for a key Skype call, to demo your skills, or create your next YouTube video, the C920x ensures you make a strong impression.This Logitech webcam can be used as a laptop camera, streaming camera, or computer camera with a microphone for desktop setups, enhancing your video conferencing or content creation experience.

    5 out of 5 stars
    Looks professional and high quality
    I decided to pick one of these up after building a PC/Hackintosh this summer and needing a Webcam for FaceTime and Zoom. I already knew from past purchases that Logitech wouldn't let me down, and they didn't. Pros: -Looks professional and high quality (which it is) -The foldable arm has a great grip on your monitor/laptop -Uses an effective low-light LED fixture for low-light rooms, which works great for video chat. -Adjusting the tilt is easy and doesn't change tilt due to gravity or anything like that -1080p30fps, great, as I'm testing Amazon AWS Facial Recognition with this Cons: -On Mac Safari full screen, the front lip sort of covers the URL bar, which annoyed me at first, but if you move your mouse to the bar and want to type a new address or search, it comes down a bit which isn't covered by that lip. So, not THAT big of a deal after all. -After I started using this, Zoom always asks me if I want to use my Blue Snowball or this webcam as my audio input source, which is annoying, because WHY would I want to use this webcam Mic over the Blue Snowball? I really only care about the camera. But you can disable the messages, just annoying in MacOS. -Sometimes the camera lags on long FaceTime calls 1hr+ and I have to end the call and call back. Annoying, but it's rare. Zoom has NEVER given me an issue with camera lag. I can only assume this is a Hackintosh issue. Summary: All in all, I would buy this again for another PC setup, should I require one in the future. It's a great price for such a high-quality Logitech webcam. If you're debating about this one, don't hesitate. It's worth it and less than those expensive Razer streaming webcams. P.S. -- Don't be scared away by my monitor quality, it shows up way worse when I take a picture with my phone. The camera quality is true to specs, 1080p30fps.

      ★★★★★ Easy, Affordable Fix for a Computer Without a Camera

      I recently bought a new computer and was surprised to discover it didn't have a built-in camera. Rather than replacing the computer or spending a lot of money on accessories, I picked up this Logitech webcam.

      It turned out to be a simple and inexpensive solution. Setup was quick, it worked right away, and the video quality has been excellent.

      The picture is clear, the microphone works well, and it has been reliable every time I've used it. Whether for video calls, meetings, or online events, it does exactly what I need it to do.

      Logitech has always made good products, and this webcam is no exception. For the price, I couldn't be happier.

      If you need to add a camera to a desktop computer or replace an older webcam, this is a great choice. It was an easy, affordable fix, and it works great.

      The Logitech C922x HD Pro

      Webcam has been a great upgrade for my setup. The video quality is very sharp and clear at 1080p, and the 720p at 60fps option is perfect for smoother video during calls or streaming. Colors look natural, and the automatic light correction does a great job even in lower lighting, which means I don't have to constantly adjust my room lighting.

      Setup was quick and easy-plug and play with no issues on my computer. It works seamlessly with Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and Google Meet, and the autofocus keeps the image crisp without annoying lag.

      The built-in dual microphones also sound surprisingly clear for a webcam, making it great for meetings without external mic.

      The build quality feels solid, and the adjustable clip mounts securely on my monitor. Overall, this webcam delivers excellent performance for the price and is a reliable choice for remote work, video calls, or content creation. Highly recommend.

      The Logitech C922x Pro Stream has truly exceeded my expectations. As someone who frequently streams and participates in video calls, I needed a reliable and high-quality webcam, and this product delivers on all fronts.

      First and foremost, the video quality is outstanding. The 1080p resolution at 30fps provides crystal clear, sharp images, and the autofocus works seamlessly to ensure that the picture remains clear even with movement. The low-light correction is another excellent feature, allowing for great video quality even in less-than-ideal lighting conditions.

      The dual microphones capture audio clearly and naturally, making sure my voice comes through loud and clear. This is particularly important for streaming and video conferencing, where sound quality is just as crucial as video quality. I no longer need to use an external microphone, which simplifies my setup.

      One of the standout features is the 60fps at 720p option. For gamers and streamers, this is a game-changer as it provides smooth and fluid video, enhancing the viewing experience for the audience. The background replacement technology is also a fun and useful tool for adding a professional touch to streams and videos.

      Setting up the Logitech C922x Pro Stream is a breeze. It's a plug-and-play device, so I was up and running in no time. The included tripod is a nice addition, providing flexibility in positioning the camera for the best angle.

      The build quality is robust and sleek, making it a stylish addition to my desktop setup. Logitech's software provides additional customization options, allowing for fine-tuning of video settings to get the perfect shot every time.

      Overall, the Logitech C922x Pro Stream is an exceptional webcam that I highly recommend to anyone looking to enhance their streaming, video conferencing, or content creation experience. Its superior video and audio quality, combined with easy setup and useful features, make it a top choice for professionals and hobbyists alike.

      The background removal technology works quite well on this camera. Obviously, it works better with a more "simple" background. I found in my bedroom, even with my bedding, laundry, and wall posters in the background this camera still did the trick (although the image was blurry/cut off my arms). I am going to try this camera with a green screen to see if that significantly improves the background removal technology. I use this camera with personify (the supplied program) and OBS and found that it worked well when streaming/recording. The only weakness is the compatibility of OBS and personify. OBS will crash if you try to have a normal webcam source and a source with background removal. Personify isn't the best program in the world, however, it was sufficient to performing the basic tasks I needed

      If you are just looking for a solid webcam, this is a great option. The light absorption and auto-focus technologies were quick and responsive. Even when I opened my window and had the sunlight shining directly on the camera, it was able to focus and produce a (reasonably) clear and well lit image
